tasks.prompt: Your friend told you that a local animal shelter is looking for volunteers to help with various tasks, such as taking care of dogs and cats, keeping records of adoption requests, and handling social media accounts. You would like to apply.
bullets: ●   Explain why you want to volunteer.

tasks.subject: Volunteer application

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
  ●   Express and support your opinion.
  ●   Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've recently been discussing various methods of stress management. Some people find physical exercise to be the most effective way to manage stress, while others prefer mindfulness and meditation techniques. What do you think is the best way to manage stress? Why?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I believe physical exercise is the best way to manage stress. Exercise helps the body release toxins and helps improve a person's mood. It also helps to clear the mind and improve overall health, making it easier to cope with life and work responsibilities.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: In my opinion, mindfulness and meditation are the most effective stress management techniques. These practices rely on effective breathing techniques and help individuals stay present and focused, reducing anxiety and promoting a sense of calm. They can be done anywhere and require no special equipment.
